# Quizify

> Turn lecture notes, textbook excerpts, and study documents into interactive AI-generated quizzes in seconds. Supports PDF and DOCX uploads, multiple question formats, difficulty levels, AI explanations, and study summaries.

## What it does
Quizify is a free web application that converts study material into interactive quizzes using AI. Users upload a PDF or DOCX document, or paste text directly, and receive a customized quiz.

## Features
- Question formats: multiple choice, true/false, fill-in-the-blank, matching pairs, situational scenarios, or a mixed set
- Adjustable difficulty (easy, medium, hard) and question count (1-50)
- AI-generated explanations for any question
- AI-generated one-paragraph study summaries
- Instant scoring and answer feedback
- Dark and light mode

## How to use
1. Upload a PDF/DOCX file or paste at least 100 characters of study text.
2. Choose the number of questions, difficulty, and question format.
3. Generate the quiz, answer the questions, and review explanations.

## Technical notes
- Built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS; quiz generation runs server-side via an AI API (opencode by default).
- Uploaded documents are parsed locally in the browser; only extracted text is sent to the server and nothing is stored.
